title: Engine adapter: this-that-model (FLock, 1.9B, MIT)
description: MIT, probabilities per option, MPS, CPU, CUDA, plus a GGUF mirror. Good test of the GGUF fallback path.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Engine adapter: this-that-model answers a scored task

Scenario: The GGUF fallback path is exercised
  Given the this-that-model (FLock, 1.9B, MIT) model with an MPS/CPU/CUDA build and a GGUF mirror
  When I run bd run --engine this-that-model --backend gguf on a committed task
  Then it returns a probability per option for every item via the GGUF fallback path and studies/ records the answers

right_now_summary: The GGUF fallback test checks that this-that-model returns option probabilities and records answers.
